index {collection}.{index}: equal is {equal}, but the index has {fields} fields.
No query could fix more fields than the index has.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: an index's equal is larger than its number of fields. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
